Container.Name: UniFi-WiFi-Access-Manager
Container.Overview: Manage which devices may access UniFi WiFi, including per-client allow and block schedules, with an audit log.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Web UI port

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database (unifi-wifi.db) and WAL files

Config.Name: APP_USERNAME
Config.Description: Web UI username

Config.Name: APP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Web UI password (set this or APP_PASSWORD_HASH)

Config.Name: APP_PASSWORD_HASH
Config.Description: Optional scrypt password hash

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Long random session signing key (openssl rand -base64 48)

Config.Name: UNIFI_HOST
Config.Description: Controller URL, e.g. https://192.168.1.1

Config.Name: UNIFI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations API key

Config.Name: UNIFI_USERNAME
Config.Description: Local-only UniFi admin for block/unblock

Config.Name: UNIFI_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the local-only UniFi admin

Config.Name: UNIFI_SITE_ID
Config.Description: Optional site UUID (multi-site consoles)

Config.Name: UNIFI_SITE
Config.Description: Classic API site name

Config.Name: APP_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Default schedule timezone (IANA name)

Config.Name: AUTO_APPLY
Config.Description: Apply desired states and schedules automatically

Config.Name: DRY_RUN
Config.Description: Log intended controller calls without sending them

Config.Name: AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Days to keep audit entries; 0 = forever

Config.Name: SCHEDULER_ENABLED
Config.Description: Run the background schedule/reconcile loop

Config.Name: SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Schedule evaluation interval

Config.Name: DISCOVERY_ENABLED
Config.Description: Import connected WiFi clients as unmanaged devices

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set true only when the Web UI is behind HTTPS

Config.Name: UNIFI_TLS_VERIFY
Config.Description: Verify the controller TLS certificate

Config.Name: UNIFI_CA_BUNDLE
Config.Description: Optional CA bundle path for a private certificate

Config.Name: UNIFI_TLS_INSECURE
Config.Description: Disable TLS verification (not recommended)

Config.Name: ENABLE_SSID_ALLOWLIST
Config.Description: Enable experimental per-SSID MAC allowlist writes
